newsitem.title: UK: Williams near peak on disposal report.
newsitem.headline: Williams near peak on disposal report.

text.p: Shares in Williams Holdings Plc rose on Monday after press reports said the fire protection and security products group planned to sell its building products units for as much as 300 million stg, traders said.

The stock was up 4-1/2p at 368 by 0847 GMT, near its year's high of 373p set last month. "If they can get rid of the building products businesses their rating would improve," said analyst Andrew Darke at Williams de Broe. "The interesting thing is who would buy them and how much they would pay."
The reports said assets being lined up for sale included Smallbone Kitchens, Amdega conservatories and Valor fires.

Last month Williams posted an 11.4 percent rise in first-half pre-tax profit to 114.9 million stg and said it was looking for more acquisitions. It gave no hint that its building products activities could be up for sale.
A spokesman for the company declined comment but said the latest reports were a rehash of earlier stories suggesting Williams was poised to make disposals.
"There is no change from the policy we have stated openly which is to invest in our core businesses of fire protection, security and international building products," the spokesman said.
